test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 11 Oct 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
There are seven row houses, M, N, 0, P, Q, R and S, in a campus, but not necessarily in the same sequence. P is not at any of the ends. R is to the immediate right of P. S is third from the left. O is at the left end. M is second from the right. O is not besides N.

Where is R located?
solution:
There are seven row houses, M, N,O,P, Q, R and S, in a campus, but not necessarily in the same sequence

1) S is third from the left. 

2) O is at the left end.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5c5cd72a20e5afd32cdcfb98bb27e08240c87f54d9c27083fb45d68ed1411bae.png] 

3) M is second from the right.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/720f2ea63d5877f2b8ceba71b6a810213f4167fbbc481c57087ac14b98336534.png] 

4) P is not at any of the ends. 

5) R is to the immediate right of P.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/fd553646726d49a2556ba43ab62022b299790a212b1fef53b1488174939c741b.png] 

6) O is not besides N.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/110c210de129529ebf31ad9025017390d686040928e083e21543ec8506be8104.png] 

Positions of all houses.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/80f3f2270e210d8b7383a5d0a1e37eb692b31f358774e25732503e13ba843222.png] 

∴ Here R is located 'Third from the right'.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Third from the right".**
